content.full_text: Start of studies First semester welcome Enrolment ceremony & orientation days Study plan for first semester students Special regulation for first semester students Living in Berlin Accommodation Communications & Account HTW account : Your personal account provides access to online services, exam registrations and learning platforms. HTW e-mail : Official means of communication: All important messages from the university are sent here. Instructions for e-mail LSF : Online portal for study organisation, e.g. timetable, course registration, exam registration and grade overview. Instructions for LSF Moodle : Learning platform with course materials, assignments and forums. Instructions for Moodle Important deadlines & documents Academic calendar Semester dates at a glance Semester fee To be paid before the start of the semester. Forms & documents Important documents for your studies Study organisation Module registration : Course enrolment takes place in several phases. There are special regulations for certain groups (e.g. students with children). Examination periods : There are two examination periods per semester, which are announced via the academic calendar. Examination registration : Examinations must be registered. Please note the deadlines and regulations of your examination regulations. Compulsory internship : There are special formalities and registration processes for the compulsory internship in the Bachelor's programme. Foreign languages : Bachelor's students must take at least one foreign language and choose an examination option.
